# Ezekiel 27 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 27:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | Then the LORD gave me another message: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 27:25 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Ships-of Tarshish were-your-caravans for-your-trade; and-you-were-filled and-made-very-glorious in-the-heart-of the-seas. |
| LOGOS | The ships of Tarshish were your carriers of merchandise. You were filled and heavily laden in the heart of the seas. |
| PNEUMA | The great ships of Tarshish were your trade fleet, loading and unloading cargo. You were like a magnificent ship, loaded with riches in the heart of the sea. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

## 27:3 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-say to-Tyre, who-dwells at-the-entrances-of the-sea, merchant-of the-peoples to many coastlands: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Tyre, you-have-said, "I [am] perfect in-beauty."' |
| LOGOS | Say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrances to the sea, merchant of the peoples to many coastlands, thus says the Lord GOD: O Tyre, you have said, 'I am perfect in beauty.' |
| PNEUMA | Give Tyre this message from the Sovereign LORD: O city of merchants, you are a famous trading port! You have boasted, 'I am the most beautiful city in the world.' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
